title: External effect supervisor
description: Objective: implement atomic work claim, lease/slot/budget reservation, effect intent, one-use activation, process observation, cancel, and restart reconciliation for one Claude node. Deliverable: runner supervisor modules and daemon work services. NOT in scope: multiple execution-bearing nodes, fan-in, Codex, or automatic approval. Hard dependencies: Lease presence core, Conserved budget core, Projection outbox core, Claude runtime adapter, and Planning graph lifecycle core. Owned paths: packages/runner/src/supervisor/** and apps/daemon/src/work/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/runner test && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test.
definitionOfDone: No external action occurs before effect.activate and attempt/effect become active together or neither.
Start/cancel/release/restart races end in one legal state with current token, epoch, budget, and runtime closure revalidated.
Duplicate delivery adopts the registered process or exits before provider launch; uncertainty is SUSPECT or UNKNOWN, never blind relaunch.
Both focused runner and daemon test commands exit 0.
taskRails: Follow the pinned design; this task cannot create authority beyond its named contract.
Fail closed with stable codes and immutable deterministic outputs.
Keep production modules focused, target <=250 lines, split before 400.
Use TDD and stage only explicit owned paths; no worktree, broad add, push, or merge.
